issues.description: The URL is /design/step-2 but the page displays what appears to be step-1 content (room type selection). The step indicator shows 'STEP 1 OF 4'. After selecting a room, the 2x2 style image grid for anchor question 1 of 3 is not shown — the page is stuck showing only the room selection UI without transitioning to style image selection.
issues.root_cause: The step-2 page.tsx likely renders the room type selection UI (which should be step-1 behavior) rather than the anchor style image grid. Either the routing is wrong (step-1 content is in step-2 file), or the page has no state management to show the style image grid after room selection. The progress indicator hardcodes 'STEP 1 OF 4' instead of showing the correct step.

issues.description: After selecting a room type, the expected 2x2 grid of 4 style images for anchor question 1 of 3 does not appear. The page shows no image loading state, no style selection UI, and no images from Supabase storage.
issues.element: Style image grid / anchor question UI
issues.root_cause: The step-2 page likely lacks the state transition logic: when a room is selected, it should update state and render the anchor style image selection component. The images from Supabase storage are never fetched or displayed.
